q1.explanationZh: kind“仁慈的”加 -ness 构成名词 kindness“仁慈；好意”。

q2.explanationZh: king“国王”，女王是 queen，王国是 kingdom。

q3.explanationZh: king 加 -dom 构成 kingdom“王国”，如 the United Kingdom“英国”。

q4.explanationZh: kiss 可作动词也可作名词，give sb. a kiss“吻某人一下”。

q5.explanationZh: kit“成套工具”，如 a first-aid kit“急救箱”。

q6.explanationZh: kitchen“厨房”，注意 t 后面是 ch。

q9.explanationZh: knee“膝盖”，开头的 k 不发音。

q10.explanationZh: kneel“跪下”，过去式 knelt，k 不发音。

q11.explanationZh: knife“刀”，复数是 knives，k 不发音。

q12.explanationZh: knit“编织”，过去式 knitted（也作 knit），k 不发音。

q13.explanationZh: knock 动词“敲；碰撞”，名词“敲击”，knock at the door“敲门”。

q14.explanationZh: know“知道；认识”，过去式 knew，过去分词 known。

q15.explanationZh: know 的名词形式 knowledge“知识”，一般不可数。

q16.explanationZh: knowledge 加 -able 构成形容词 knowledgeable“知识渊博的”。

q18.explanationZh: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写，都表示“实验室”。

q19.explanationZh: label 名词“标签”，动词“贴标签；把……归类为”。

q20.explanationZh: labour 是英式拼写，美式拼写为 labor。

q21.explanationZh: lack 作名词和及物动词都表示“缺乏”，lack of“缺乏……”。

q23.explanationZh: lady“女士”，复数 ladies，Ladies and gentlemen“女士们，先生们”。

q25.explanationZh: lamb“小羊；羔羊肉”，结尾的 b 不发音。

q26.explanationZh: lame“跛的”，还可表示“站不住脚的”，如 a lame excuse。

q28.explanationZh: land 名词“陆地；土地”，动词“着陆”。

q29.explanationZh: land + lord 构成 landlord“房东；地主”。

q30.explanationZh: landscape“景色”，指一大片陆地的风景。

q32.explanationZh: language“语言”，注意 gua 的拼写。

q34.explanationZh: lap 是同形词：名词“（坐着时的）大腿部”，动词“拍打”。

q35.explanationZh: lap“大腿”+ top“上面”= laptop“笔记本电脑”。

q36.explanationZh: large“大的”，多指面积、数量、范围大。

q38.explanationZh: be known as“作为……而出名”，as 后接身份。

q39.explanationZh: be known for“因……而出名”，for 后接原因。

q40.explanationZh: be known to“为……所知”，to 后接人。

accept: be in lack of 或 lack for

q42.explanationZh: 答案给出 be in lack of 或 lack for，都表示“缺乏”。

q43.explanationZh: land safely“安全着陆”，副词 safely 修饰动词 land。

q44.explanationZh: lame“跛的”，lame in the left foot“左脚瘸”。

q46.explanationZh: on the ground“在地面上”，ground 指地面。

q48.explanationZh: a large number of“大量的”，后接可数名词复数。

accept: It is known to all that ...
It is known to all that…
It is known to all that
it is known to all that

q50.explanationZh: It is known to all that ...“众所周知……”，it 是形式主语。

q51.explanationZh: know about“听说过”，对某人或某事有所耳闻。

q52.explanationZh: “传说很久以前那儿住着一位国王”，a 后用单数 king。

q53.explanationZh: fly a kite“放风筝”，a 后用单数。

q54.explanationZh: “她把毛线织成毛衣”，knit wool into sth.，叙述过去用过去式 knitted。

q55.explanationZh: can 后接动词原形，knock the wall through“把墙打通”。

q56.explanationZh: science lab“科学实验室”，the 后用单数。

q57.explanationZh: “月光下湖看起来很美”，谓语 looks 是单数，用 lake。

q58.explanationZh: lame in the left foot“左脚瘸”，与 blind 并列作表语，用形容词。

q59.explanationZh: “他和楼下的房东发生了争执”，landlord“房东”。

q60.explanationZh: the foreign land“异国土地”，land 作名词。

q61.explanationZh: the ... in the world 用最高级，large 的最高级是 largest。

q62.sampleAnswer: Labour practice not only allows us to appreciate the value of labour but also fosters the spirit of craftsmanship, thereby contributing to long-term personal growth.
references: Labour practice not only allows us to appreciate the value of labour but also fosters the spirit of craftsmanship, thereby contributing to long-term personal growth.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “不仅……还……”= not only ... but also ...；“从而助力”可用现在分词 thereby contributing to。

q63.sampleAnswer: They have succeeded by their own labour.
references: They have succeeded by their own labour.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “通过自己的努力”= by their own labour，labour 在这里表示“努力；劳动”。

q64.sampleAnswer: Your smile is the best way to show people your kindness.
references: Your smile is the best way to show people your kindness.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “……的最好方式”= the best way to do；show sb. sth.“向某人展示某物”。

q65.sampleAnswer: It is known to all that lack of sleep will contribute to memory decline.
references: It is known to all that lack of sleep will contribute to memory decline.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “众所周知”= It is known to all that ...；“睡眠不足”= lack of sleep；“导致”= contribute to。

q66.sampleAnswer: Travelling at sea is more comfortable than travelling over land.
references: Travelling at sea is more comfortable than travelling over land.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 动名词作主语，“海上”= at sea，“陆上”= over land，比较级 more comfortable than。

q67.sampleAnswer: The trees and the mountains made the landscape very beautiful.
references: The trees and the mountains made the landscape very beautiful.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “使……变得……”= make + 宾语 + 形容词，landscape 表示“风景”。

q68.sampleAnswer: On finishing dinner, she couldn’t help inviting us to take a walk along the beautiful lake near her home.
references: On finishing dinner, she couldn’t help inviting us to take a walk along the beautiful lake near her home.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “一……就……”= on doing；“忍不住做”= can’t help doing；“沿着湖边散步”= take a walk along the lake。

q69.sampleAnswer: The children learned to put their knives and forks down on the plates after eating.
references: The children learned to put their knives and forks down on the plates after eating.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: knife 的复数是 knives；“学会做”= learn to do；“用完餐后”= after eating。

q70.sampleAnswer: It’s essential for a student majoring in economics to have a good knowledge of finance/rich financial knowledge.
references: It’s essential for a student majoring in economics to have a good knowledge of finance/rich financial knowledge.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: 用 It’s essential for sb. to do 句型；“主修”= major in；have a good knowledge of“对……很了解”。

q71.sampleAnswer: The Chinese language is one of the most difficult languages in the world, so people who are learning it soon feel themselves challenged.
references: The Chinese language is one of the most difficult languages in the world, so people who are learning it soon feel themselves challenged.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “最……之一”= one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，所以用 languages；“发现自己遇到挑战”= feel themselves challenged。
